# Identity for AI

> AI agents should consult [Docs for Agents](https://developer.pingidentity.com/build-with-ai/docs-for-agents.md)
> for guidance on navigating Ping Identity documentation.

## Identity For Ai

- [Agent types](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/identity/idai-agent-types.md): Classify AI agents into types (personal agents, digital assistants, and digital workers) and learn their identity security implications.
- [Authorizing autonomous Gemini agents with Ping Identity solutions](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/integrations/idai-authorizing-gemini-autonomous-agents-with-ping.md): Authorize an autonomous Gemini agent calling an MCP tool with scoped, short-lived delegation tokens.
- [Authorizing Gemini Agent2Agent (A2A) chains with Ping Identity solutions](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/integrations/idai-authorizing-gemini-agent2agent-with-ping.md): Authorize a Gemini Agent2Agent chain that delegates the user's token throughout the chain.
- [Authorizing Gemini agents on behalf of users with Ping Identity solutions](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/integrations/idai-authorizing-gemini-on-behalf-of-users-with-ping.md): Authorize a Gemini agent acting on behalf of a user to call an MCP tool with scoped, short-lived delegation tokens.
- [AuthPlayground](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/authplayground.md): Explore OAuth 2.0 extension protocols through an enterprise AI scenario in the AuthPlayground.
- [AuthPlayground concepts](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/authplayground-concepts.md): Explore OAuth 2.0 protocols, trust boundaries, identities, and authorization controls for enterprise AI workflows in the AuthPlayground.
- [Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD) in the AuthPlayground](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/authplayground-cimd.md): Explore how Client ID Metadata Documents help OAuth servers discover and evaluate dynamic AI and MCP clients in the Identity for AI AuthPlayground.
- [Computer-using agents (CUAs)](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/agents/idai-computer-using-agents.md): Learn about the identity and security challenges of computer-using agents (CUAs) that interact with GUIs and CLIs instead of APIs.
- [Cross-App Access (XAA) / ID-JAG in the AuthPlayground](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/authplayground-xaa-id-jag.md): Explore how XAA and ID-JAG carry delegated user identity across authorization domains in the AuthPlayground.
- [Demonstrating Proof of Possession (DPoP) in the AuthPlayground](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/authplayground-dpop.md): Explore how DPoP binds OAuth access tokens to a caller's key and prevents copied tokens from being replayed in enterprise AI workflows.
- [Full Cross-Domain Access in the AuthPlayground](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/authplayground-cross-domain-access-xaa.md): Explore an end-to-end AuthPlayground flow combining OAuth protocols to preserve identity and protect cross-domain enterprise AI access.
- [Getting started with the AuthPlayground](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/authplayground-getting-started.md): Get started with the AuthPlayground to explore OAuth 2.0 flows through simulated HTTP exchanges and decoded JSON Web Tokens (JWT).
- [How agents use tools](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/agents/idai-tools-intro.md): Learn how AI agents use external tools to perform actions and access real-time data, and how MCP and A2A protocols secure and govern tool use.
- [Identifying agents with token exchange](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/identity/idai-token-exchange.md): Use OAuth 2.0 token exchange to identify AI agents in a delegation chain with nested act claims, creating an audit trail back to the human user.
- [Identity for AI](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/index.md): Landing page for Identity for AI documentation covering Ping Identity's comprehensive solution for AI agent security, governance, and identity management.
- [Integrating Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform with Ping Identity solutions](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/integrations/idai-integrating-gemini-agent-platform-with-ping.md): Introduction to Gemini Agent Platform integration with Ping Identity authorization solutions, including architecture and prerequisites.
- [Key Identity for AI terminology](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/glossary/idai-glossary.md): Definitions for key Identity for AI terms, including agent types, AI and machine learning concepts, and IAM practices and protocols.
- [Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) in the AuthPlayground](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/authplayground-pkce.md): Explore how PKCE protects OAuth authorization-code redemption from interception attacks in the AuthPlayground.
- [Protected Resource Metadata in the AuthPlayground](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/authplayground-resource-metadata.md): Explore how Protected Resource Metadata helps AI and MCP clients discover authorization requirements in the AuthPlayground.
- [Pushed Authorization Requests (PAR) in the AuthPlayground](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/authplayground-par.md): Explore how Pushed Authorization Requests establish OAuth requests before browser redirects in the AuthPlayground.
- [Rich Authorization Requests (RAR) in the AuthPlayground](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/authplayground-rar.md): Explore how Rich Authorization Requests express fine-grained operations that OAuth policies can evaluate in the AuthPlayground.
- [Secure Production Identity Framework for Everyone (SPIFFE) in the AuthPlayground](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/authplayground-spiffe.md): Explore how SPIFFE gives AI agents and other workloads verifiable identities in the AuthPlayground.
- [Securing a Cloudflare Workers MCP server with PingFederate](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/integrations/idai-securing-cloudflare-pingfed.md)
- [Securing a Cloudflare Workers MCP server with PingOne](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/integrations/idai-securing-cloudflare-pingone.md)
- [Securing a Cloudflare Workers MCP server with PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/integrations/idai-securing-cloudflare-aic.md)
- [Securing a Cloudflare Workers MCP server with PingOne DaVinci](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/integrations/idai-securing-cloudflare-davinci.md)
- [Securing AI Agents with PingFederate using delegated access tokens](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/use-cases/idai-securing-agents-pingfed.md)
- [Securing AI agents with PingOne using delegation and least privilege](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/use-cases/idai-securing-agents-pingone.md): Configure PingOne and PingGateway to secure AI agents using OAuth 2.0 token exchange, consent workflows, and least-privilege MCP server protection.
- [Securing Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity with Ping Identity](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/integrations/idai-securing-aws-ping.md)
- [Securing an MCP server with PingGateway](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/identity/idai-securing-mcp-servers-gateway.md): Use PingGateway as a security gateway to intercept, validate, audit, and enforce OAuth 2.1 authorization on AI agent requests to MCP servers.
- [Securing digital assistants](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/use-cases/idai-securing-digital-assistants.md): Secure AI agents using explicit agent identity, delegation with OAuth 2.0 token exchange, and an agent gateway for least-privilege enforcement.
- [Securing MCP servers with OAuth 2.0](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/identity/idai-securing-mcp-servers-oauth.md): Best practices for securing MCP servers with OAuth 2.0, covering authorization server architectures and requirements.
- [Token Exchange in the AuthPlayground](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/authplayground-token-exchange.md): Explore how OAuth Token Exchange preserves subject and actor identities while retargeting trust for enterprise AI access in the AuthPlayground.
- [Transaction Tokens in the AuthPlayground](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/authplayground-transaction-tokens.md): Explore how transaction tokens preserve trusted context through distributed AI service call chains in the AuthPlayground.
- [What are AI agents?](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/agents/idai-what-are-agents.md): Learn about AI agent architecture, core components, reasoning loops, multi-agent workflows, and how agents automate real-world tasks.
- [What is Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol?](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/idai-what-is-a2a.md): Learn how the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol enables AI agents to discover, authenticate with, and delegate tasks to other agents across frameworks.
- [What is Identity for AI?](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/getting-started/idai-what-is-identity-for-ai.md): Learn about Identity for AI, a comprehensive solution designed to secure, manage, and govern AI systems and data.
- [What is Model Context Protocol (MCP)?](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/protocols/idai-what-is-mcp.md): Learn how Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes AI agent connections to external tools, resources, and prompts.
- [What&#8217;s new?](https://developer.pingidentity.com/identity-for-ai/release-notes/idai-whats-new.md): Learn about new developments in Identity for AI, Ping Identity's solution for securing,  managing, and governing AI systems and data.
